Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiActuatingFunctionInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiActuatingFunctionInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiActuatingFunctionInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source evidence for one DEXPI actuating-function occurrence.

This record preserves explicit XML identity and references without inferring control intent, final-element type, safeguard classification, or live simulation topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      Creates immutable evidence for one actuating-function occurrence.
      Parameters:
      id - source XML identity, or an empty string when absent
      kind - explicit source kind
      componentClass - source component class
      functionNumber - explicit source function-number metadata, or an empty string
      instrumentationFunctionId - enclosing instrumentation-function identity, or an empty string
      instrumentationFunctionResolved - whether the enclosing identity resolves to the enclosing source element
      instrumentationFunctionElementName - enclosing XML element name, or an empty string
      finalControlElementId - explicit final-control-element reference, or an empty string
      finalControlElementResolved - whether the final-control-element reference resolves
      finalControlElementName - resolved final-control-element XML name, or an empty string
      locationId - explicit is located in reference, or an empty string
      locationResolved - whether the location reference resolves
      locationElementName - resolved location XML name, or an empty string
